title: Dragonwilds Velgar Guide | Boss Mechanics, Gear & Strategies
author: Thurnax
description:
Having trouble defeating Velgar?

In this guide, I'll walk you through everything you need to know to consistently defeat Velgar using melee, ranged, or magic.

We'll cover the recommended gear, attack patterns, mechanics, positioning, consumables, and strategies for each combat style so you can earn your kill with confidence.

📌 In this guide:
Velgar mechanics explained
Best melee setup
Best ranged setup
Best magic setup
Attack pattern breakdown
Recommended gear
Food & consumables
Positioning tips
Common mistakes to avoid

This is the first in my Dragonwilds Boss Guide Series, with guides for every major boss coming soon.

Looking for other Dragonwilds players? Join the Thurnax Enclave Discord community to share builds, ask questions, and group up with the community.

If this guide helped you, consider leaving a like and subscribing for more Dragonwilds progression guides, boss guides, and endgame content.

— Thurnax

#Dragonwilds #RuneScapeDragonwilds #Velgar #DragonwildsBossGuide
